description: Set the flat value on one env. Sets the flat `value` on a single `env`, publishing one new version on that env only. `switches` and other envs are untouched.

env.description: Target environment. One of the project's configured envs (`dev`, `staging`, `prod`).

id.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

value.description: Flat boolean to publish on `env`. Publishes a new version on that env only.

name: release_killswitch_set_value
